Put `PuppetMaster` and `RagdollManager` folders from [PuppetMaster asset](https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/physics/puppetmaster-48977) here.

Only `RagdollManager/Scripts/*.cs` is needed to build `ml_prm`. The
`PuppetMaster` folder is unused and doesn't compile on Unity 6.

`PuppetMaster/` and `RagdollManager/` are git-ignored - paid asset code.
Keep the sources unmodified.
